proposal.summary: ImageMagick 7.1.0-49 can hang (denial of service) when parsing a PNG image: the convert process may be left waiting for stdin input during image parsing (for example during resize).
proposal.cwe_quote: When it parses a PNG image (e.g., for resize), the convert process could be left waiting for stdin input.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the exact vendor advisory or patch info and reproduce the issue to confirm attack vector and required attacker access; if confirmed, apply vendor patch or mitigate by validating/sanitizing PNG inputs and running convert with restricted time/resource limits.
